purpose: Fingerprint of the shared 68ponyGT package folder, to stop vehicle archives from downgrading it
title: 68ponyGT H145 Action Pack Common Objects - Standard
manifestVersionNote: All 68ponyGT packages declare 0.1.0, so the version cannot tell old from new

canonicalSource.name: H145 ActionPack HEMS Objects v1.1
canonicalSource.checked: 2026-10-14: 350 of 350 std-objects files identical to the folder installed on the author PC

olderCounterpartsNote: Same path as a canonical file but different content; seen only in the partial copy (114 files) carried by the country vehicle archives; the 5 archives checked: IT beta 1.1 (read earlier, not re-hashed here), DE v1.1, NL v1.1, UK v1.2, US v1.2.1. Their zip entry dates (2022-10 to 2023-01) are older than the canonical ones (2023-04 to 2023-06 on the installed copy).
preserveUnlisted: The author installed copy also holds 23 files under Simobjects/Airplanes/Smoke_FX that are in no archive checked and not in layout.json: never delete or overwrite files that are not in canonicalFiles
suggestedRule: When an incoming file has the same path as a canonical file: keep the installed file if its sha256 is the canonical one; replace only if the installed sha256 is an olderCounterpart or the file is missing; an unknown installed content is kept until classified.
